title: 第二十五章各有所图第二十六章生意
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 叶凡放下酒杯，拱了拱手，姿态压得很低。
“原来是安公子。”
“在下一个天剑宗外门弟子，不知是安公子当面，失礼了。”
安庆远却摆了摆手，半点没有架子。
“兄台不必如此。”
他给叶凡又斟满酒，神情坦荡。
“我今日来跟兄台拼座，可不是闲着没事。”
叶凡眉头一挑。
“安公子的意思是?”
安庆远笑了笑，直截了当。
“我修商道，这道不善争斗，也没什么呼风唤雨的本事。”
“但有一样，我看人，很准。”
“方才我一进门，瞧见兄台坐在这儿，就觉得不一般。”
他指了指自己的眼睛。
“我这双眼，这些年看过的人没有一万也有八千，什么人有财气，什么人是池中之物，我一眼就能瞧出来。”
“而兄台你——”安庆远顿了顿，声音里带着笑，“我敢断定，与你结交，我安庆远，必能大赚一笔。”
叶凡端着酒杯，半天没动。
他心里头，差点没乐出声来。
他正愁下山没门路，没人脉，淘换法器、收购资源全得自己一抓瞎。
结果倒好。
刚进城吃顿饭，就有个安家的嫡系凑上来，说要跟他结交，还说能让人家大赚一笔?
这哪是拼座。
这是财神爷自己上门了。
不过叶凡脸上还端着，没急着应。
他活了九十年，什么便宜都敢占，但天上掉馅饼这种事，他向来要先看看馅饼底下有没有钩子。
安庆远像是看穿了他的迟疑，也不恼，反而笑得更坦然。
“我把话说在前头。”
“我安庆远来跟兄台结交，是带着利益来的，图的就是个赚字。”
“这一点，还望兄台别介意。”
叶凡听到这话，反倒踏实了。
他最怕的，就是那种没缘由的热乎。无事献殷勤，非奸即盗。
可安庆远把话挑明了——我图你的利，你图我的钱，买卖归买卖。
这种，他喜欢。
干净。
叶凡放下酒杯，脸上那点惶恐慢慢收了，露出几分真切的笑意。
“介意?”
他摇了摇头。
“安公子这话，可是说到我心坎里去了。”
“不瞒你说，我这趟下山，正愁找不着个能搭上话的明白人。”
安庆远眼睛一亮。
“哦?这么说，兄台是有结交的意思了?”
“求之不得。”叶凡拱手。
两个人对视一眼，都从对方脸上看出了点门道。
content_en:
Ye Fan put down his wine glass and cupped his hands with a very low posture.
"It turns out to be Mr. An."
"The next outer disciple of Tianjian Sect, I don't know if Mr. An is in front of you, so you are rude."
An Qingyuan waved his hand without any airs.
"Brother, you don't have to be like this."
He filled Mark's glass with wine again, looking magnanimous.
"I'm here to share a seat with my brother today, so I won't be idle."
Ye Fan raised his eyebrows.
"What does Mr. An mean?"
An Qingyuan smiled straightforwardly.
"I practice business. This way is not good at fighting, and I don't have the ability to control wind and rain."
"But one thing is that I am very accurate in judging people."
"When I entered the door just now and saw Xiongtai sitting here, I felt something was unusual."
He pointed to his eyes.
"My eyes have seen as many as eight thousand people over the years. I can tell at a glance who has wealth and who is a treasure in the pond."
"And brother, you—" An Qingyuan paused, with a smile in his voice, "I dare to conclude that I, An Qingyuan, will make a lot of money by becoming friends with you."
Ye Fan held the wine glass and didn't move for a long time.
In his heart, he almost couldn't express his joy.
He was worried that he had no way to go down the mountain, and he had no connections, so he would have to scratch his own head when searching for magic weapons and purchasing resources.
The result was good.
As soon as he entered the city for a meal, a direct descendant of the An family came up to him and said that he wanted to make friends with him, and also said that he could make a lot of money for him?
This is not seat sharing.
This is the God of Wealth himself coming to the door.
However, Ye Fan still had a straight face and did not respond in a hurry.
He has lived for ninety years and dares to take advantage of anything. But when it comes to pie falling from the sky, he always wants to see if there is a hook under the pie.
An Qingyuan seemed to see through his hesitation and was not annoyed. Instead, he smiled more calmly.
"I'll say it first."
"I, An Qing, came far to befriend Xiongtai. I came here with the interests in mind. I only wanted to make money."
"I hope you don't mind this, brother."
When Ye Fan heard this, he felt at ease.
What he fears most is that kind of heat without any reason. Showing courtesy for nothing is either cheating or stealing.
But An Qingyuan made it clear - I am after your profit, you are after my money, business is business.
He likes this.
clean.
Ye Fan put down his wine glass, and the fear on his face slowly disappeared, revealing a genuine smile.
"Mind?"
He shook his head.
"Mr. An's words have touched my heart."
"To tell you the truth, on my way down the mountain, I was worried that I couldn't find anyone sensible to talk to."
An Qingyuan's eyes lit up.
"Oh? So, brother, you are interested in making friends?"
"I can't ask for it." Ye Fan handed over his hand.
The two people looked at each other and saw something on each other's faces.
